<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>RESULTADOS 2025 - GESTIÓN GPS</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
        body { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; overflow: hidden; background: #e8f4f8; }
        .slide-container { width: 100vw; height: 100vh; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
        .bg-landscape {
            position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
            background: url('data:image/jpeg;base64,') center/cover no-repeat;
            z-index: 0;
        }
        .bg-overlay {
            position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 100%);
            z-index: 1;
        }
        .portada-content {
            position: relative; z-index: 10; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100%;
            text-align: center; padding: 0 60px;
        }
        .portada-main-title {
            font-size: 64px; font-weight: 900; color: #1e3a5f;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
            letter-spacing: 6px; line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: 15px;
            animation: fadeInUp 1s ease forwards;
        }
        .portada-subtitle {
            font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #334155;
            text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
            letter-spacing: 6px; text-transform: uppercase;
            animation: fadeInUp 1s ease 0.3s forwards; opacity: 0;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }
        .portada-line {
            width: 120px; height: 4px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #22c55e, transparent);
            margin: 15px auto 30px; border-radius: 2px;
            animation: fadeInUp 1s ease 0.5s forwards; opacity: 0;
        }
        .logo-mask-container {
            position: relative; width: 220px; height: 220px;
            animation: fadeInUp 1s ease 0.7s forwards; opacity: 0;
        }
        .logo-ring {
            position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0;
            width: 220px; height: 220px; border-radius: 50%;
            border: 3px dashed rgba(30, 58, 95, 0.3);
            animation: spinRing 20s linear infinite;
        }
        .logo-ring:nth-child(2) {
            top: 5px; left: 5px; width: 210px; height: 210px;
            border: 2px dashed rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.25);
            animation: spinRing 15s linear infinite reverse;
        }
        .orbit-dot {
            position: absolute; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
        }
        .orbit-dot:nth-child(4) { top: -5px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: #1e3a5f; }
        .orbit-dot:nth-child(5) { bottom: -5px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: #22c55e; }
        .orbit-dot:nth-child(6) { left: -5px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); background: #eab308; }
        .orbit-dot:nth-child(7) { right: -5px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); background: #f97316; }
        .logo-mask-circle {
            position: absolute; top: 10px; left: 10px;
            width: 200px; height: 200px; border-radius: 50%;
            overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
            animation: pulseLogo 3s ease-in-out infinite;
            background: white; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        }
        .logo-mask-circle img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; object-position: center; padding: 8px; }
        @keyframes pulseLogo { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.05); } }
        @keyframes spinRing { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
        .portada-year {
            font-size: 100px; font-weight: 900; color: rgba(30,58,95,0.06);
            position: absolute; bottom: 100px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
            letter-spacing: 20px; z-index: 5;
        }
        .nav-btn {
            position: absolute; bottom: 35px; z-index: 100;
            padding: 16px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
            font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
            text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }
        .nav-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }
        .nav-next {
            right: 50px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #22c55e, #16a34a); color: white;
        }
        .nav-next:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #16a34a, #15803d); }
        @keyframes fadeInUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .portada-main-title { font-size: 40px; }
            .portada-subtitle { font-size: 18px; }
            .logo-mask-container { width: 160px; height: 160px; }
            .logo-mask-circle { width: 140px; height: 140px; top: 8px; left: 8px; }
            .logo-ring { width: 160px; height: 160px; }
            .logo-ring:nth-child(2) { width: 150px; height: 150px; top: 4px; left: 4px; }
        }
    </style>
<base target="_blank">
</head>
<body>
<div class="slide-container">
    <div class="bg-landscape"></div>
    <div class="bg-overlay"></div>
    <div class="portada-content">
        <div class="portada-main-title">RESULTADOS<br>2025</div>
        <div class="portada-subtitle">Gestión GPS</div>
        <div class="portada-line"></div>
        <div class="logo-mask-container">
            <div class="logo-ring"></div>
            <div class="logo-ring"></div>
            <div class="logo-mask-circle">
                <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Logo GPS">
            </div>
            <div class="orbit-dot"></div>
            <div class="orbit-dot"></div>
            <div class="orbit-dot"></div>
            <div class="orbit-dot"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="portada-year">2025</div>
    </div>
    <button class="nav-btn nav-next" onclick="location.href='slide2.html'">
        <span>Siguiente</span>
        <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
    </button>
</div>
</body>
</html>
